title: metadata-protocol: the #28905 overlay-write refusal sentence does not name `os migrate packageless-overlays`, the ceremony that now moves a base-bound row into its pair
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQJdgarUjPLNgFBY67

Filing gate: ① an out-of-scope finding of the #29392 dev (os-dev-report `6581838503`, open question 4), accepted by the seat on PR #29477. Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 (text only: the remedy exists, the refusal just does not point to it).

## What happens

The #28905 close refuses a write that names a read-only code package on the five overlay types with `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`. The sentence comes from `closedOverlayWriteClauses` in `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`. It names the pair fix: declare the override in the base's `.custom` pair.

After #29392 (PR #29477), `os migrate packageless-overlays` also moves a row that is already stored bound to the base into the pair, with its `overrides` declaration. The refusal does not mention that ceremony. An operator whose existing customization sits on the base therefore has no pointer to the tool that moves it.

## Wanted

- Add one clause to the refusal sentence, in `closedOverlayWriteClauses` (one spelling, every door), naming `os migrate packageless-overlays` for rows already stored bound to the base.
- Update the pins that assert the sentence.
- ⛔ No second spelling.

Serial: after #29390, #29414 and #29397, which touch the same refusal module. Seat 3 runs them in order.

Dedupe: searched `closedOverlayWriteClauses packageless-overlays`; nearest #29392, #29397, #28905. **New.**

Links back: #29392, #29477, #28905, #29397.
